name: 47532 · Ferdinand, IN
findings: ZIP 47532 (Ferdinand) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47532 (Ferdinand) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47532 (Ferdinand) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
